source.title: Northern Whig, 4 June 1927, p. 8 ("Ballymena Rural Council")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: votes read on the block image of the Northern Whig results of 4 June 1927 and checked against the Belfast News-Letter and Irish News of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 in Ballyclug, Broughshane, Galgorm and Portglenone only. The other divisions were filled unopposed: sixteen are named from the nomination list (Ballymena Observer, 6 May 1927, p. 10) and the withdrawals report (13 May 1927, p. 10). Slemish, Toome and Tullaghgarley are not printed in the reports traced. No party labels are printed. Houston 278; Wilson 146; majority 132.
